summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state initialized in __init__, set and cleared in run_async (cleared in a finally after _shutdown), and a new test module tests/test_concurrency.py. All 9 new tests pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src. The rest of the suite (excluding snapshot_tests, cli, devtools) has the same 68 failures as the untouched base, caused by the venv lacking the async test plugin; tests/cli and tests/devtools could not be collected because aiohttp is missing. Nothing was committed, and the venv was not modified.
